name: 66208 · Prairie Vlg, KS
findings: ZIP 66208 (Prairie Vlg) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66208 (Prairie Vlg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66208 (Prairie Vlg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
